Respondent - Municipal Corporation has deposited a sum of Rs.30,00,000/-
towards proposed amount of compensation in respect of land taken over possession of, belonging to the petitioners.
Acquisition proceedings are said to have been at initial stage.
Last time Land Acquisition Officer had submitted that as per the ready reckoner value of the land in the year 2017, the price thereof was not less than Rs.28,00,000/-.
2. Admittedly, the amount of compensation has to be ascertained.
In view of the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
Necessarily the amount of compensation would be more than what has been deposited with this 746.2019CP Court.
